name: FirstUK Bank Product Portfolio
description: The complete set of banking products offered by FirstUK Bank as documented in the Product Pricing Guide 2026. This is the master product portfolio document effective from 2026-01-15, managed by the Head of Product Management.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The banking institution issuing and maintaining retail banking products covered in this pricing guide. FirstUK Bank is the service provider responsible for all fees, charges, and interest rates documented herein.
context: FirstUK Bank maintains competitive, transparent pricing across all retail banking products
This guide shows all fees, charges, and interest rates effective January 15, 2026

name: Pricing Review and Update Policy
description: A contractual provision establishing that FirstUK Bank reviews all pricing quarterly and updates fees, charges, and interest rates as needed. This defines the bank's right and obligation to modify product pricing on a regular schedule.
context: Prices reviewed quarterly and updated as needed

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A variable rate savings account offered by FirstUK Bank with interest calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a 2.5% margin. Rates are reviewed monthly and became effective 2026-01-15.
context: Bank of England Base Rate + 2.5% Margin

name: SmartSaver Account Base Rate Tier
description: The variable interest rate applied to SmartSaver Account balances, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a fixed 2.5% margin. Rate is reviewed and adjusted monthly.
context: Base Calculation: Bank of England Base Rate + 2.5% Margin

name: Savings Account Tier 1 Rate
description: Interest rate applied to balances from £0 to £10,000. Both AER and gross rates are 4.50%. Interest is calculated daily and accrued monthly, paid on the last business day of each month.

name: Savings Account Tier 2 Rate
description: Interest rate applied to balances from £10,001 to £50,000. Both AER and gross rates are 4.70%. Interest is calculated daily and accrued monthly, paid on the last business day of each month.

name: Savings Account Tier 3 Rate
description: Interest rate applied to balances of £50,001 and above. Both AER and gross rates are 4.80%. Interest is calculated daily and accrued monthly, paid on the last business day of each month.

name: Interest Accrual Feature
description: Interest is calculated on a daily basis and accrued monthly, with payment made on the last business day of each month. This feature ensures regular interest crediting to the customer's account.
context: Interest Accrual: Monthly (calculated daily, paid on last business day of month)

name: Savings Account with Variable Rate
description: A savings product with interest rates that vary based on Bank of England Base Rate changes. The product features a fixed margin of 2.5% above the BoE Base Rate, with rates reviewed monthly and adjusted on the 1st of the following month.
context: Bank of England Base Rate changes
Rate change effective 1st of following month

name: Rate Change Notification
description: Customers receive email alerts when interest rates change on their savings account. This is an opt-in feature that notifies customers of rate adjustments triggered by Bank of England Base Rate movements.
context: Email alert when rate changes (customer can opt-in)
Notification: Email alert when rate changes

name: Variable Rate Tier
description: The interest rate applied to the savings account, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a fixed margin of 2.5%. This rate is reviewed monthly and adjusted effective the 1st of the following month.
context: Basis: BoE Base Rate + 2.5% Margin (fixed margin)

name: Rate Variation and Notification Clause
description: Contractual provision governing how and when interest rates are adjusted on the savings account. Specifies that rate changes are triggered by Bank of England Base Rate movements, reviewed monthly, and become effective on the 1st of the following month, with customer notification via email.
context: Trigger: Bank of England Base Rate changes
Effective Date: Rate change effective 1st of following month

name: Current BoE Base Rate Reference
description: Reference to the current Bank of England Base Rate as of 2026-01-15, set at 4.0%. This rate serves as a benchmark for banking products and customer interest calculations.

name: Monthly Maintenance Fee
description: A monthly service charge levied on the account. This product explicitly offers no monthly maintenance fee, positioning it as a cost-free account option.

name: Overdraft Facility
description: An overdraft borrowing facility that allows customers to draw funds beyond their account balance. This product explicitly does not offer an overdraft facility.

name: Minimum Opening Balance Requirement
description: The minimum initial deposit required to open an account under this product. Customers must deposit at least £1.00 to establish the account.

name: Maximum Balance Limit
description: The upper limit on account balance that a customer may hold. This product places no restriction on the maximum balance a customer can accumulate.

name: ATM Withdrawal Fee (UK)
description: No charge levied on customers for withdrawals at UK ATMs. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 fee feature.

name: ATM Withdrawal Fee (International)
description: Charge of £2.50 levied on customers for withdrawals at international ATMs outside the UK.

name: International Transfer Fee
description: Charge of £5.00 levied on customers for international money transfers sent outside the UK.

name: Domestic Transfer Fee
description: No charge levied on customers for transfers between UK accounts. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 fee feature.

name: Standing Order Fee
description: No charge levied on customers for setting up or maintaining standing order payment instructions. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 fee feature.

name: Direct Debit Fee
description: No charge levied on customers for setting up or maintaining direct debit mandates. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 fee feature.

name: Debit Card Initial Issuance Fee
description: No charge levied for the initial issuance of a debit card to a customer.

name: Card Replacement Fee
description: A £15.00 charge applied when a customer requests a replacement debit card through standard processing.

name: Expedited Card Replacement Fee
description: A £25.00 charge applied when a customer requests expedited replacement of a debit card with 1–2 day delivery.

name: Virtual Card Number Fee
description: No charge levied for the issuance or use of a virtual card number for online shopping transactions.

name: Debit Card
description: A debit card issued to customers for payment transactions, with initial issuance at no cost and replacement available at standard or expedited rates.

name: Virtual Card Number
description: A virtual card number feature provided at no cost for secure online shopping transactions.

name: Account Closure Fee
description: No charge levied for closing an account with FirstUK Bank. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 feature.

name: Statement Reprint Fee
description: No charge for requesting a reprint of account statements. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 feature.

name: Dormancy Letter Fee
description: No charge for issuing a dormancy letter on an account. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 feature.

name: Chequebook Fee
description: No charge for a chequebook when offered on the account. This is explicitly called out as a £0.00 feature.

name: SmartSaver Plus Account
description: A premium savings product offered by FirstUK Bank with variable interest rates reviewed monthly. The account requires a minimum balance of £50,001 and earns interest calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a 2.75% margin.
context: Base Calculation: Bank of England Base Rate + 2.75% Margin

name: SmartSaver Plus Account Variable Rate
description: The variable interest rate tier for SmartSaver Plus Account, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus 2.75% margin, reviewed monthly. Applies to balances of £50,001 and above.

properties.rate_basis: Bank of England Base Rate + 2.75% Margin

context: Base Calculation: Bank of England Base Rate + 2.75% Margin

name: SmartSaver Plus Minimum Balance Requirement
description: Customers must maintain a minimum balance of £50,001 to qualify for the advertised variable interest rate on the SmartSaver Plus Account.

name: Interest Rate Tier - All Balances
description: A single-tier interest rate structure applied to all account balances without minimum or maximum thresholds. Interest accrues monthly at an Annual Equivalent Rate (AER) of 5.25%.

name: Premium Account
description: A premium savings product offered by FirstUK Bank with no monthly account fee, offset by higher interest rates compared to standard accounts. Shares fee structure with SmartSaver Account for all charges beyond the account maintenance fee.
context: Premium Account Fee: £0.00 (offset by higher rates)
All Other Fees: Same as SmartSaver Account

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A standard savings account product referenced as the fee benchmark for Premium Account. All fees applicable to Premium Account beyond the account maintenance fee are identical to SmartSaver Account.
context: All Other Fees: Same as SmartSaver Account

name: Premium Account Monthly Maintenance Fee
description: No monthly maintenance fee charged on the Premium Account. The absence of this fee is explicitly called out as a feature, with the benefit offset by higher interest rates offered on the product.
context: Premium Account Fee: £0.00 (offset by higher rates)

name: Higher Interest Rate Benefit
description: A premium feature of the Premium Account that offsets the £0.00 monthly maintenance fee through elevated interest rates compared to standard savings products.
context: Premium Account Fee: £0.00 (offset by higher rates)

name: Premium Banking Product
description: A premium banking product that includes dedicated relationship management, priority customer service, financial planning reviews, and waived international transfer fees as value-added services.

name: Dedicated Relationship Manager
description: A dedicated relationship manager providing phone support to customers as part of the premium banking service offering.

name: Priority Customer Service
description: Priority customer service with a guaranteed 24-hour response time for customer inquiries and requests.

name: Annual Financial Planning Review
description: An annual financial planning review service provided to customers as part of the premium banking offering.

name: International Transfer Fee
description: International transfer fees that are waived for customers holding this premium banking product.

name: Current Account
description: A current account product offered by FirstUK Bank with no interest paid on deposits. The account includes an arranged overdraft facility charged at 15.00% AER.

name: Current Account Overdraft Rate
description: The interest rate charged on arranged overdrafts for the Current Account product, applied when the account holder borrows within an agreed overdraft limit.

name: No Interest Feature
description: A feature of the Current Account whereby no interest is paid on deposits held in the account.
context: Savings Interest: £0.00 (no interest on current account)

name: Arranged Overdraft Facility
description: An optional overdraft facility available on the Current Account that allows account holders to borrow up to an agreed limit, subject to interest charges.

name: Arranged Overdraft
description: An overdraft product allowing customers to borrow up to an agreed limit with a fixed interest rate. This example shows a £1,000 arranged overdraft charged at 15% AER with transparent daily, monthly, and annual interest calculations.

name: Unarranged Overdraft
description: An overdraft facility for unplanned borrowing without prior arrangement with the bank. Charged at a significantly higher rate of 25% AER plus a daily fee, and explicitly marked as not recommended.
context: Unarranged Overdraft: 25.00% AER + £5 daily fee (not recommended)

name: Arranged Overdraft Interest Rate
description: The interest rate applied to arranged overdraft balances up to £1,000. Charged at 15% AER with transparent daily, monthly, and annual interest accrual.

name: Unarranged Overdraft Interest Rate
description: The interest rate applied to unarranged overdraft balances. Charged at 25% AER, significantly higher than the arranged rate.
context: Unarranged Overdraft: 25.00% AER + £5 daily fee (not recommended)

name: Unarranged Overdraft Daily Fee
description: A daily charge levied on unarranged overdraft balances. Applied at £5 per day in addition to the 25% AER interest rate.
context: Unarranged Overdraft: 25.00% AER + £5 daily fee (not recommended)

name: Monthly Account Fee
description: A recurring monthly charge levied on the account. This product explicitly features no monthly fee, positioning it as a cost-free account maintenance offering.

name: Overdraft Arrangement Fee
description: A one-time charge applied when an overdraft arrangement is first established on the account. This product waives the fee on the initial overdraft arrangement setup.

name: Domestic Transfer Fee
description: No charge levied on customers for domestic transfer transactions.

name: International Transfer Fee
description: Charge of £8.00 applied to international transfer transactions.

name: UK ATM Withdrawal Fee
description: No charge levied on customers for ATM withdrawals within the United Kingdom.

name: International ATM Withdrawal Fee
description: Charge of £3.00 applied to ATM withdrawals made outside the United Kingdom.

name: Unarranged Overdraft Fee
description: Daily charge of £5.00 applied to unarranged overdraft balances, in addition to interest at 25.00% AER.

name: Arranged Overdraft Rate
description: Interest rate applied to arranged overdraft balances at 15.00% AER.

name: Unarranged Overdraft Rate
description: Interest rate applied to unarranged overdraft balances at 25.00% AER, plus a daily fee of £5.00.

name: Card Fee
description: Card fees applicable to the SmartSaver Account, stated as equivalent to those of the parent product. No explicit card fee amount is charged; total annual cost is £0.00 with no overdraft use.

name: Overdraft Interest Charge
description: Interest charged on overdraft usage. When a £2,000 overdraft is used, the total annual cost is approximately £300 in interest charges.
context: Total Annual Cost (With £2,000 Overdraft Usage): ~£300 (interest only)

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A savings product referenced in the context of card fees and annual cost calculations. The document cross-references this product for fee details.

name: Mortgage Product
description: A mortgage product offered by FirstUK Bank with multiple rate options including fixed-rate and variable-rate terms. The product provides customers with flexibility in choosing between 2-year fixed, 5-year fixed, or tracker variable rate mortgages.

name: Mortgage Fixed Rate 2 Year
description: A fixed interest rate mortgage option with a 2-year term. The rate remains constant throughout the fixed period, providing payment certainty to the customer.

name: Mortgage Fixed Rate 5 Year
description: A fixed interest rate mortgage option with a 5-year term. The rate remains constant throughout the fixed period, providing extended payment certainty to the customer.

name: Mortgage Variable Rate Tracker
description: A variable interest rate mortgage option that tracks an underlying benchmark rate. The rate adjusts periodically in line with market movements, offering potential savings if rates fall.

name: Residential Mortgage
description: A residential mortgage product offered by FirstUK Bank with multiple fixed-term and variable rate options across different loan-to-value bands. Rates vary based on LTV ratio and term length, with both fixed 2-year and 5-year options as well as variable rate alternatives.

name: Residential Mortgage Fixed 2-Year Rate <60% LTV
description: Fixed 2-year mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value below 60%. This tier represents the lowest LTV band and offers the most competitive fixed rate.

name: Residential Mortgage Fixed 5-Year Rate <60% LTV
description: Fixed 5-year mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value below 60%. This tier offers a longer fixed-rate commitment at a higher rate than the 2-year equivalent.

name: Residential Mortgage Variable Rate <60% LTV
description: Variable mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value below 60%, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a 1.5% margin. At the current BoE Base Rate of 4.0%, this equates to 5.50%.
context: Current Variable Rate Example (at BoE Base 4.0%): 5.50% (Base 4.0% + 1.5% margin)

name: Residential Mortgage Fixed 2-Year Rate 60–80% LTV
description: Fixed 2-year mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value between 60% and 80%. This mid-range LTV tier carries a higher rate than the <60% band.

name: Residential Mortgage Fixed 5-Year Rate 60–80% LTV
description: Fixed 5-year mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value between 60% and 80%. This tier reflects the mid-range LTV band with a longer fixed-rate commitment.

name: Residential Mortgage Variable Rate 60–80% LTV
description: Variable mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value between 60% and 80%, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a 1.75% margin.

name: Residential Mortgage Fixed 2-Year Rate 80%+ LTV
description: Fixed 2-year mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value of 80% or above. This highest LTV tier carries the most premium rate reflecting increased lending risk.

name: Residential Mortgage Fixed 5-Year Rate 80%+ LTV
description: Fixed 5-year mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value of 80% or above. This highest LTV tier with longer commitment carries the most premium rate.

name: Residential Mortgage Variable Rate 80%+ LTV
description: Variable mortgage rate for residential mortgages with loan-to-value of 80% or above, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a 2.25% margin. This highest LTV tier carries the largest margin.

name: Fixed Rate 2-Year Mortgage
description: A fixed-rate mortgage product where the interest rate is fixed for a 2-year period, after which the rate is re-fixed. This product protects the customer from interest rate fluctuations during the initial fixed period.
context: Fixed Rate 2-Year: Fixed for 2 years, then re-fixed

name: Fixed Rate 5-Year Mortgage
description: A fixed-rate mortgage product where the interest rate is fixed for a 5-year period, after which the rate is re-fixed. This product provides longer-term rate protection compared to the 2-year variant.
context: Fixed Rate 5-Year: Fixed for 5 years, then re-fixed

name: Early Repayment Fee (Fixed Rate)
description: A penalty fee charged to the customer if they repay the mortgage early during the fixed rate period. The fee is typically calculated as a percentage of the outstanding balance.

properties.trigger_event: Early repayment during fixed rate period

context: Early Repayment Fee (Fixed Rate): Typically 1–3% of outstanding balance (if early repayment during fixed period)

name: Rate Re-fixing Provision
description: A contractual provision that governs the automatic re-fixing of the mortgage interest rate at the end of the initial fixed period. The customer's rate will be re-fixed to a new rate determined by the bank at that time.

name: Mortgage Arrangement Fee
description: A fee charged for arranging a mortgage, which is included at no separate cost to the customer under FirstUK Bank's mortgage product.

name: Mortgage Valuation Fee
description: A fee for property valuation required as part of the mortgage application process. FirstUK Bank covers this cost at no charge to the customer.

name: Mortgage Legal Fee
description: Legal fees for conveyancing services associated with the mortgage transaction. This cost is borne by the customer and typically ranges from £1,200 to £2,000.

name: Mortgage Booking Fee
description: A fee charged to lock in a mortgage interest rate. FirstUK Bank charges £0.00 for this service.

name: Mortgage Protection Insurance
description: An optional insurance product available to mortgage customers that provides protection against specified risks. The cost and coverage vary depending on the insurance provider selected.
context: Mortgage Protection Insurance | Optional, varies by provider
| Mortgage Protection Insurance | Optional, varies by provider |

name: Fixed Rate Mortgage
description: A mortgage product with a fixed interest rate that protects the customer against rate rises during the fixed term. The example shows a £200,000 mortgage at 5.00% fixed rate over a 25-year term.
context: Fixed rate protects against rate rises during term

name: Fixed Rate Mortgage Tier 1
description: The initial fixed interest rate tier for the first 2 years of the mortgage term at 5.00% AER, applicable to a £200,000 mortgage over 25 years.

name: Fixed Rate Mortgage Tier 2
description: The fixed interest rate tier applicable from Year 3 onwards if the mortgage is re-fixed at 5.50%, resulting in a monthly payment of £1,267.99.

name: Rate Protection Feature
description: A feature of the fixed rate mortgage that protects the customer against interest rate rises during the fixed term period, providing payment certainty.
context: Fixed rate protects against rate rises during term

name: Visa Debit Card
description: A Visa-branded debit card issued to customers for transaction access. The card carries no annual fee but incurs replacement charges depending on delivery speed.

name: Debit Card Annual Fee
description: No annual fee is charged for holding and using the Visa Debit Card.

name: Debit Card Replacement Fee
description: A fee charged when a replacement debit card is issued. Standard replacement costs £15.00, while expedited delivery within 1–2 days costs £25.00.

name: UK ATM Withdrawal Fee
description: No charge levied on customers for withdrawals at UK ATMs, subject to a daily limit of £500.

name: International ATM Withdrawal Fee
description: A charge of £2.50 per withdrawal applied to international ATM transactions, with a daily limit of £300.

name: Contactless Payment Fee
description: No charge levied on contactless payment transactions, subject to a per-transaction limit of £100.

name: Online Purchase Fee
description: No charge levied on online purchases, subject to Visa's transaction limits.

name: Point of Sale Fee
description: No charge levied on point of sale transactions with no transaction limit.

name: International Purchase Fee
description: No direct transaction fee charged on international purchases; however, Visa's exchange rate of approximately 2% applies.

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A savings account product offered by FirstUK Bank, positioned as the most competitive option in the market with a Tier 1 interest rate of 4.50% for balances under £10,000, no monthly fee, and a minimum opening balance of £1.

name: SmartSaver Account Tier 1 Rate
description: The interest rate tier for SmartSaver Account balances under £10,000, offering 4.50% AER, positioned as the most competitive rate compared to market competitors.

name: SmartSaver Account Monthly Fee
description: No monthly maintenance fee is charged on the SmartSaver Account, explicitly called out as a feature matching competitor offerings.

name: SmartSaver Account Minimum Opening Balance Requirement
description: The SmartSaver Account requires a minimum opening balance of £1, the lowest threshold among the three products compared, making it highly accessible to new customers.

name: Current Account
description: FirstUK's current account offering, positioned competitively against rivals with no monthly fee and competitive overdraft rates. Featured in a product comparison table highlighting key differentiators.

name: Monthly Fee
description: FirstUK Current Account charges no monthly maintenance fee, explicitly called out as a competitive advantage versus Competitor A's £15 monthly charge.

name: Current Account Overdraft Rate
description: FirstUK Current Account applies a 15% overdraft rate, positioned as more competitive than Competitor A (18%) and Competitor B (16%).

name: ATM Fee (UK)
description: FirstUK Current Account charges no fee for UK ATM withdrawals, matching Competitor A but undercutting Competitor B's £1.50 charge.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The banking institution issuing and managing products referenced in this pricing philosophy document. FirstUK Bank commits to transparency, competitive rates, and clear communication of all charges to customers.
context: FirstUK Bank aims for transparency and competitiveness
Match or beat market for key products

name: No Hidden Fees Policy
description: A commitment that all charges are clearly stated to customers with no undisclosed or surprise fees. This feature differentiates FirstUK Bank's approach to pricing transparency.
context: No Hidden Fees: All charges clearly stated

name: Competitive Rate Matching
description: FirstUK Bank commits to matching or beating market rates for key products, ensuring customers receive competitive interest rates relative to the broader market.
context: Competitive Rates: Match or beat market for key products

name: Clear Cost Communication
description: A commitment to ensure customers understand their costs associated with banking products and services through clear, transparent communication.
context: Clear Communication: Customers understand their costs

name: Quarterly Pricing Review
description: FirstUK Bank conducts a quarterly review of its pricing to maintain competitiveness in the market. This establishes the frequency and process by which rates and fees may be adjusted.
context: Regular Review: Quarterly pricing review to stay competitive

name: Review Schedule Policy
description: A contractual provision establishing the frequency and timing of product review and rate adjustment cycles. The policy mandates quarterly reviews as market conditions change, with monthly adjustments for variable rates tied to the Bank of England base rate.
context: Quarterly Reviews: As market conditions change
Rate Changes: Monthly (for variable rates tied to BoE)

name: Quarterly Review Trigger
description: A contractual provision that permits the bank to conduct product reviews on a quarterly basis whenever market conditions change, enabling timely adjustments to product terms and rates.
context: Quarterly Reviews: As market conditions change

name: Monthly Variable Rate Adjustment
description: A contractual provision establishing that variable rates tied to the Bank of England base rate are adjusted monthly, ensuring customer rates track BoE movements on a regular schedule.
context: Rate Changes: Monthly (for variable rates tied to BoE)

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A variable-rate savings product offered by FirstUK Bank with tiered interest rates ranging from 4.50% to 4.80% APR, dependent on balance tier. Interest is paid gross with no tax deducted, and customers are responsible for reporting to HMRC if liable.
context: Interest Paid: Gross (no tax deducted). Customers must report to HMRC if liable.

name: Mortgage Product
description: A mortgage product with variable APR ranging from 5.00% to 5.75%, varying by product type and loan-to-value (LTV) ratio. PPI insurance is not included but available as an optional add-on.
context: PPI Insurance: Not included (optional add-on available for mortgages)

name: SmartSaver Tier 1 Rate
description: The lower tier interest rate for SmartSaver Account, part of a variable tiered structure with rates ranging from 4.50% to 4.80% APR depending on balance thresholds.

name: SmartSaver Tier 2 Rate
description: The higher tier interest rate for SmartSaver Account, part of a variable tiered structure with rates ranging from 4.50% to 4.80% APR depending on balance thresholds.

name: Mortgage Fixed Rate
description: Mortgage interest rate tier with APR ranging from 5.00% to 5.75%, varying by product type and loan-to-value (LTV) ratio.

name: Gross Interest Payment Feature
description: Interest on savings products is paid gross without tax deduction, with customers responsible for reporting to HMRC if they are tax-liable.
context: Interest Paid: Gross (no tax deducted). Customers must report to HMRC if liable.

name: Optional PPI Insurance Add-on
description: An optional Payment Protection Insurance add-on available for mortgage products, not included as standard.
context: PPI Insurance: Not included (optional add-on available for mortgages)

name: Tax Reporting Obligation
description: A contractual provision requiring customers who receive gross interest payments to report their interest income to HMRC if they are tax-liable.
context: Customers must report to HMRC if liable.

name: Online Rate Calculator Access
description: Customer resource providing online access to interest rate calculations for FirstUK Bank products. Available via dedicated web portal for customer self-service rate comparison.

name: Product Comparison Tool
description: Customer-facing tool enabling side-by-side comparison of FirstUK Bank products and their features. Accessible online to support informed product selection.

name: Frequently Asked Questions Resource
description: Centralized online repository of customer FAQs covering common product and service inquiries. Provides self-service guidance on FirstUK Bank offerings.

name: FirstUK Bank Customer
description: Individual customer of FirstUK Bank with access to online resources, rate calculators, product comparison tools, and customer service support.
